integrity: The two omitted multiplication tables are taken from a published complete two-dimensional complex associative classification. Their quasi-centroids, and those of all five remaining classes, are recomputed directly from the defining equation. An exact symbolic checker independently reconstructs the seven linear solution spaces.
scientific_limitations: The correction concerns only the two-dimensional theorem; higher-dimensional tables were not re-audited.
The completeness of the seven underlying complex associative algebra classes uses a published classification theorem, while every quasi-centroid computation is independently reconstructed.
A later or unindexed correction to the 2023 preprint may exist.
title: Two omitted classes in the two-dimensional associative quasi-centroid table
